back:
The watch window is a window where you can add variables you would like to continually inspect, and these variables will be updated as you step through your program. The watch window may already be on your screen when you enter debug mode, but if it is not, you can bring it up through your IDE’s window commands.

In Visual Studio, the watch window can be found at Debug menu > Windows > Watch > Watch 1. Do note that you have to be in debug mode for this option to be enabled, so step into your program first.
source_prefix: In order to address this issue, all modern integrated debuggers provide another feature, called a watch window. The watch window is a window where you can add variables you would like to continually inspect, and these variables will be updated as you step through your program.
